card.name: Link word before a protected or owned object
card.fires_on: Small linking words (on, of, with, a) right after a verb or noun of illegal or restricted acts, such as encroachment, rubbings, reproduction, abuse, misappropriating. The next word is expected to be someone's property, a protected thing or a victim.

modes.label: Trespass or taking
modes.description: Link word after a property-violation term, before land or owned goods.
modes.example: charges of encroachment<< on>> state land

modes.label: Copying or restricted use
modes.description: Link word after copying, reproducing or photographing, before the protected item.
modes.example: No reproduction<< of>> text, or photographs for commercial purposes

modes.label: Harm to a person or creature
modes.description: Link word after abuse or interference, before a child or animal.
modes.example: It may be illegal to mess<< with>> them these days

card.writes: It favors words like private, protected, copyrighted and minors, which name owned or protected things and people.
card.plain: It fires on the small word after a term for an illegal act, just before the protected thing or person is named.
